stop: Stop after both groups complete: they give the Prop. 2/3 phase diagram (ambiguity by probe set, envelope class, delta, parent size N<=8) and the envelope-misspecification check of board prediction S1 (docs/board/theory.md).
_doc: Role theory, lane free. Tasks cfcap/theory_task.py:PHASE (episode code scripts/theory_nuisance.py run_episode: parametric box image under motor-spread / mu boxes at delta 0.04/0.08/0.16 and the speed-only nonparametric class for probe sets v2, v2+clamp, v2+22.5deg oblique, v2+2x yaw, v2+clamp+2x yaw; 4-8-module parents, 1-2 faults weak/coast/brake) and :ENVELOPE (knee-envelope truth vs two-constant oracle fitted at the parent's probes, v2 and v2+clamp, 4-6-module parents). CPU only, torch at 1 thread, outputs = runner npz units (no parquet). Analysis: results/theory (theory_nuisance.py analyze style; envelope: unsafe-go and |rho_hat - rho_true| by dominance class).

groups.name: phase
groups.pilot: theory 2026-11-25, local i7 host, 1 thread (OMP=1), python -m cfcap.runner theory_phase --task-spec cfcap.theory_task:PHASE --seeds 0:1 --sizes 4 (runner smoke ok, npz units) and run_episode at 1 thread: N=6 parent 4.0 s, N=8 parent 14.5 s (390 rows), N=4-6 mean 2.5 s at 4 threads (results/theory, 200 parents); unit of 10 episodes at sizes 4-8 estimated 100 s, set to 150 s for the large-polyomino tail and slower worker cores
groups.purpose: Quasi-static phase diagram of counterfactual decision ambiguity by probe set, envelope class and motor spread over 4-8-module polyomino parents (theory Prop. 2 and 3).
